overview_description.description: StubHub operates an online marketplace that facilitates the buying and selling of event tickets. The platform covers a wide range of events including concerts, sports games, theater performances, and live entertainment shows. It provides users with tools to browse listings, compare prices, and select seats that fit their preferences. StubHub also offers interactive seat maps to help customers visualize their event experience before purchasing. In addition to ticket sales, the company supports features such as mobile ticket delivery and customer support to address transaction-related inquiries. The platform functions as an intermediary, connecting individuals or organizations looking to sell tickets with those seeking to attend events. This model allows greater access to events by creating a secondary market for tickets.

press_references.value: FTC Issues Formal Warning to StubHub Over Slow Rollout of ‘All-In’ Pricing

legal_proceedings.description: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) issued a formal warning to StubHub for failing to comply with the new 'all-in' pricing rule on its mobile app, which requires ticket sellers to display the total price of tickets upfront. The FTC noted that StubHub's delayed compliance coincided with the release of the NFL 2025 schedule, potentially giving the company an unfair advantage during a high-traffic period. While no immediate penalty was issued, the FTC warned that further non-compliance could result in enforcement actions and significant fines.

legal_proceedings.description: A cybercrime crew stole and resold over 900 digital tickets to Taylor Swift concerts and other events on StubHub, generating over $600,000 in profits. Two individuals, Tyrone Rose and Shamara Simmons, were arrested and charged with grand larceny and other crimes.

The office, located at 7000 Central Park, covers almost 56,000 square feet and will house over 200 employees, with plans to hire more. This move is part of a broader trend of out-of-town tech companies establishing a presence in Atlanta.
